newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TRADE ACTIVE, HANSA RESULTS MOVE MARKET HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: TRADE ACTIVE, HANSA RESULTS MOVE MARKET HIGHER.

text.p: bourse was active after the four-day weekend and prices moved
higher with the support of Hansapank group's May results,
Hansapank released its group May results which dealers said
were good and supported the whole market to move higher.
Forekspank was the most active stock with 12 million kroons
traded to be higher at 193/194.20 kroons compared to 189.50
On the free market, Norma was the most traded
